label: sparse D1-only feature, enriched after unrewarded trials and mid-episode
explanation: Fires only at D1 (100% of activation mass; never at GO or D2) but on just ~5% of D1 steps, and no observed variable isolates which ones. Enrichments are weak: prev_reward==0 (lift 1.7, 68% of mass), previous transition rare (1.9x), good==S1 (1.3x), mid-range model value (5.2-7.5 holds ~95% of mass, but precision is only 9%), and a strong dependence on episode position (peaks at trials 50-89, nearly silent at trials 90-99 and early in the episode). The top activations (near max) are mostly unrewarded D1s after a long streak of rewarded common trials, but low-quartile activations also occur after rewarded trials. It never fires at d1_err steps or on penalty inputs. The best conjunctions (D1 & prev_reward==0 & trial 50-89, F1 0.20; D1 & value band, F1 0.17) do not beat the phase baseline by much, so the phase predicate is recorded. Its precision is very low; the feature probably depends on a slowly drifting hidden-state direction that no task variable captures.
